contract.title: Your commitment contract
contract.intro: This contract sums up what you commit to for this budget cycle. Once signed it cannot be edited.

routines.level.off.help: The bot does nothing and the routine does not appear in your schedule.
routines.level.remind.help: The bot sends a message on time. No penalty.
routines.level.track.help: The bot reminds you and asks for a check-in, recorded for the weekly review. No penalty.

privacy.title: Consents, export and deletion
privacy.error: Could not load your consents. Please try again.
privacy.consent.title: Consents
privacy.consent.help: Each feature stays off until you allow it. Turning a consent off stops the feature at once.
privacy.export.title: Export your data
privacy.export.help: Download all of your data as a machine-readable archive. The link works for a limited time.
privacy.export.failed: Could not prepare the export. Please try again.
privacy.delete.title: Delete your account
privacy.delete.help: Deleting erases your personal data. Suspended or due penalties are never erased and keep the account closing until they are settled. Export your data first if you want a copy.
privacy.delete.warning: This cannot be undone. Your personal data will be erased now.
privacy.delete.label: Type your account email to confirm
privacy.delete.not_confirmed: The email does not match your account. Nothing was deleted.
privacy.delete.failed: Could not complete the request. Please try again.
privacy.delete.closing: Your data is erased. The account stays closing until your penalties are settled.
privacy.delete.closed: Your account is closed and your data is erased.
privacy.consent.camera.help: Lets the app analyse your face on your device while you focus. Video never leaves the device.
privacy.consent.vision_frame: Single frame to a vision model on appeal
privacy.consent.vision_frame.help: Sends one frame to a vision model only when you appeal or the result is unclear.
privacy.consent.wake_photo: Wake-up photo through chat and an AI provider
privacy.consent.wake_photo.help: Lets you send a wake-up photo through chat to an AI provider.
privacy.consent.email.help: Lets the app read bank emails you forward to your address.
privacy.consent.bank.help: Lets the app read transaction facts. It never moves money.
privacy.consent.google_sync.help: Lets the app write to your Google Sheets and Calendar.
